stories.title: Wella Professionals launches Make It You campaign
stories.summary: Wella Professionals has launched its global campaign Make It You in India. The campaign features brand ambassador Manushi Chhillar and hairstylist Avan Contractor to emphasize hair as a means of personal expression. The company says the initiative aims to strengthen bonds with consumers and the hairdressing community.

stories.title: Dabur Honey highlights quality credentials in new film
stories.summary: Dabur India has launched a television commercial for Dabur Honey, focusing on testing across 22 parameters, traceability and AGMARK Special Grade certification. The film depicts families using the product in daily routines. The company states that trust is what makes its honey special to consumers.

stories.title: Nike to become official Formula 1 apparel provider
stories.summary: Nike and Formula 1 have entered a long-term global partnership starting in the 2027 race season. Nike will provide apparel for F1 staff and release sportswear collections. A limited-edition collection debuts on November 20 during the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend at Caesars Palace.

stories.title: Bhima Gold features Janhvi Kapoor in bridal campaign
stories.summary: Bhima Gold has launched a bridal jewellery campaign titled Kahani, featuring actor Janhvi Kapoor. The campaign explores how modern brides incorporate family traditions into their weddings while maintaining individual identities. It positions bridal jewellery as a multi-generational link, with pieces often passed down through families.

stories.title: Generali Central Life Insurance expands Bada Socho campaign
stories.summary: Generali Central Life Insurance has installed a Bada Socho Dreams Wall and a large Rubik’s Cube at Mumbai’s Carter Road. The initiative invites people to pledge steps toward their aspirations. The company says the activation is intended to encourage people to turn their goals into actionable commitments.

stories.title: Ferrero India names Kriti Sanon as Raffaello endorser
stories.summary: Ferrero India has appointed actor Kriti Sanon to endorse its Raffaello confectionery brand. A new campaign film features a chance meeting at a pottery class where a shared snack leads to a connection. The company says the campaign focuses on taking the first step toward building relationships.

stories.title: GoodFlip, a TatvaCare Company, Names Milind Soman as Brand Ambassador, Putting Consistency at the Heart of Metabolic Hea
Tanishq strategy focuses on emotion-led storytelling
stories.summary: Tanishq entered the Indian jewellery market in 1994 to formalize an unorganised sector. The brand built its proposition around purity and transparent pricing. It has since used emotion-led storytelling regarding marriage and women's agency to position its jewellery as a central part of social change.

stories.title: McDonald’s releases holiday film featuring Macaulay Culkin
stories.summary: McDonald’s has released a holiday commercial featuring Macaulay Culkin in a restaurant emptied by a snowstorm. The film shows him operating an unattended McFlurry machine. The commercial promotes the Home Alone Meal, which is currently reaching participating American restaurants.

stories.title: Parag Milk Foods signs Saif Ali Khan for Gowardhan Ghee
stories.summary: Parag Milk Foods has appointed Saif Ali Khan as the brand ambassador for its Gowardhan Ghee. The partnership follows a social media moment on a game show where the actor was offered a two-year supply of the product. This marks the brand's first active celebrity ambassador pursuit.

stories.title: Victoria’s Secret announces Triptii Dimri as India ambassador
Cult.fit launches campaign celebrating small fitness wins
stories.summary: Cult.fit has launched a campaign featuring Hrithik Roshan that focuses on maintaining fitness routines through small, everyday efforts. The film celebrates milestones like completing three weekly workouts or holding a plank. The company positions these smaller achievements as markers of progress for busy individuals.

stories.title: Simca Advertising secures Indian Railways contract
stories.summary: Simca Advertising has received a work order from Indian Railways for advertising services valued at 41.3 crore rupees. The five-year contract begins revenue recognition in August 2027. The company reports that Indian Railways currently accounts for approximately 89 percent of its disclosed backlog.

stories.title: Dentsu X CEO discusses decline of media RFPs
stories.summary: Bruce Williams, CEO of dentsu X North America, says standalone media RFPs are becoming obsolete. He argues that brands should move toward operating systems built around outcomes rather than channel-first planning. Media is increasingly functioning as connective tissue across creative, commerce, data and technology.

stories.title: Skydance marketing division announces new leadership
stories.summary: Following its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, Skydance has revealed a new marketing leadership structure. CMO Rebecca Mall stated the goal is to build a unified organization that breaks down silos. The team intends to harness data and technology to set new industry standards.

stories.title: Omnicom Media India integrates Interactive Avenues
stories.summary: Omnicom Media India is integrating Interactive Avenues into its wider network to create a more connected operating model. Specialist practices like CRM, MarTech and analytics will move into the Media Capabilities discipline, while creative and influencer businesses will join the global Creo network.

stories.title: Omnicom Media India consolidates agency network
stories.summary: Omnicom Media India has integrated Interactive Avenues into its broader organizational structure. The move shifts specialist practices into the company's existing discipline framework. The agency says the change is intended to strengthen its service offerings by bringing specialist expertise into a unified operating model.

stories.title: Vaishali Verma exits Initiative, Omnicom integrates Interactive Avenues across Initiative and Lodestar UM - BMI
Omnicom Media India integrates Interactive Avenues
stories.summary: Omnicom Media India has integrated digital agency Interactive Avenues into its wider network to create a more connected operating model. The move consolidates social, CRM, and analytics expertise into the group's Media Capabilities discipline. The company aims to address changing client requirements through this restructuring.

Spark Foundry wins Oppo India media account
stories.summary: Publicis Media India's Spark Foundry has reportedly won the media mandate for Oppo India, estimated at Rs 150 crore. The account covers media planning, buying, and execution, moving from Omnicom Media's PHD India. Official confirmation is pending following a review initiated earlier this year.

stories.title: Creators and the launch of GTA VI
stories.summary: Rockstar Games partnered with creators to promote the release of Grand Theft Auto VI. The game is being described as the biggest launch ever by Twitch. The marketing effort follows a 13-year wait for the latest installment in the franchise.

stories.title: Creator economy to hit $116 billion as brands hike spending to report - Campaign UK
The range of Addison Rae net worth estimates
stories.summary: Estimates of Addison Rae's net worth vary from $10 million to $25 million. Sources including Celebrity Net Worth and InvestorMint provide conflicting figures for the creator, who has expanded from TikTok into beauty, film, and music. All current financial data remains unverified.

stories.title: YouTube announces new creator programming
stories.summary: YouTube has unveiled upcoming shows from creators including Emma Chamberlain and Ina Garten. The event featured sizzle reels and on-stage talent, mirroring a traditional Hollywood upfront. The platform intends to use this programming to maintain its position atop Nielsen streaming rankings.

stories.title: Influencer marketing shifts toward performance metrics
stories.summary: India's influencer marketing industry is seeing pricing rationalisation as brands demand more value for their investments. Negotiations are moving beyond follower counts to include engagement quality and campaign performance. Creators are now expected to deliver more for the same commercial fees.

stories.title: GTA 6 expected to boost creator economy
stories.summary: Industry insiders expect Grand Theft Auto VI to generate significant opportunities for creators. A National Research Group study suggests the game rivals the Super Bowl in broad recognition. Rockstar Games has partnered with various livestreamers to leverage the franchise's cultural impact.

stories.title: Creator economy spending reaches $116 billion
stories.summary: Global spending on the creator economy is projected to reach $116 billion in 2026. Media-led activity remains the largest category, accounting for 44 percent of total expenditure. Brands are increasingly hiking their budgets to secure creator partnerships.

stories.title: YouTube hosts 24-hour livestream for GTA 6
stories.summary: YouTube is hosting a 24-hour global livestream to mark the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6. The event features over 30 gaming creators, including participants from India. The platform has billed the initiative as the biggest launch of all time.

stories.title: Mastercard and TikTok study economic mobility
stories.summary: A study by Mastercard and TikTok suggests Southeast Asia's creator economy is becoming a driver of regional economic mobility. The research, presented at the ASEAN Inclusive Growth Summit, highlights a shift from individual content creation to broader livelihood opportunities supported by digital platforms.

stories.title: Marketer spend on creators hits $116 billion
stories.summary: Global marketer spend on the creator economy is set to grow 15 percent to $116 billion in 2026, according to Madison and Wall. The report notes that advertisers are reallocating existing budgets to fund these creator-related activities. The total is predicted to reach $178 billion by 2030.

stories.title: YouTube expands creator-led show slate
stories.summary: YouTube is increasing its investment in creator-led programming to compete with streaming services. In August, the platform accounted for 15.8 percent of U.S. TV watch time, exceeding the share held by Netflix. The company is currently showcasing new content from its top creators.

stories.title: YouTube’s Next Big Bet Isn’t Virality. It’s Habit,At Least Based on the Newly Announced Creator Shows - Inc.com
Meta sued over crypto scam ads
stories.summary: A class action lawsuit alleges Meta's ad tools helped build and target cryptocurrency scam ads on Facebook and Instagram. The plaintiff claims Meta allowed the ads to run because they generated profit. Meta has not yet responded to the specific allegations regarding its ad targeting systems.

stories.title: Deepfakes used to influence Canada-US trade tensions
stories.summary: Researchers at McGill University identified a network using AI to steal the identities of content creators. The group reportedly uses deepfake videos to inflame online discourse surrounding Canada-US trade relations. Affected creators report that the AI-generated content features their faces and voices saying things they never spoke.

stories.title: Coca-Cola holiday ad avoids AI
stories.summary: Coca-Cola's 2026 holiday advertisement features a human-made aesthetic and a resurrected 1971 jingle. The brand explicitly omitted AI and its signature polar bears from the spot. The move follows an industry trend of brands attempting to reassure consumers that their creative output remains human-generated.

stories.title: Court denies Blink Digital plea against Meta
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court rejected a plea from Blink Digital India to restore four advertising accounts disabled by Meta in August. The court ruled the agency failed to establish a case for an interim injunction. Blink Digital may approach Meta for reinstatement if it ensures future policy compliance.

stories.title: Meta promotes smart glasses for parents
stories.summary: Meta's new holiday campaign, Stay in the Moment, positions its smart glasses as a tool for parents to record school plays without using a phone. The company sold over 7 million smart glasses across Ray-Ban and Oakley in 2025. AI-powered eyewear sales are forecast to hit $40 billion by 2030.

stories.title: Dutch gaming association sues Meta
stories.summary: The Dutch online gaming association VNLOK has filed a lawsuit against Meta in Amsterdam. The group alleges that Meta fails to effectively combat illegal gambling advertising on its platforms. This legal action follows a previous complaint filed by the association with the European Commission regarding Digital Services Act violations.

stories.title: Canadians file class action over Facebook investment scams
stories.summary: A proposed class action lawsuit claims Meta is responsible for investment scam ads that defrauded users of nearly $1 million. The lead plaintiff alleges she was drawn into a fake cryptocurrency platform after seeing a Facebook ad. The suit seeks to address the platform's role in hosting the content.

stories.title: Advertisers pause TikTok campaigns over CSAM
stories.summary: Several brands, including Banco Santander and Moeve, suspended TikTok campaigns in Spain after their ads appeared alongside child sexual abuse material. Digiday reports that ads from 21 brands ran before or after videos featuring CSAM or websites selling such material. The platform has not commented on the findings.

stories.title: Meta removes ads recruiting plaintiffs for addiction lawsuits
stories.summary: Meta is pulling ads from Facebook and Instagram that sought to recruit plaintiffs for litigation against the company. The lawsuits accuse Meta of designing addictive platforms for young users. Meta spokesperson Andy Stone stated the company will not allow trial lawyers to profit from its own platforms.

stories.title: EU proposes Digital Fairness Act
stories.summary: The European Union has proposed a law to ban pay-to-win features for minors and require clearer labeling for influencer ads. Companies could face fines of up to 6 percent of annual global turnover for breaches. The proposal is currently under review and is not yet law.

stories.title: Meta launches shopping platform in Brazil
stories.summary: Meta has introduced a shopping platform called Achados in Brazil. The tool aggregates product listings from across the company's various applications into a single, unified display for users.

stories.title: Threads tests Q&A format for live chats
stories.summary: Threads is experimenting with a new feature for live chats. The format allows hosts to solicit questions from participants, who can then vote on which inquiries should be addressed during the session.

stories.title: Top MarTech News From the Week of November 20th: Updates from Bloomreach, SurveyMonkey, Panopto, and More - Solutions Re
Ryla.ai automates influencer content
stories.summary: Ryla.ai has launched a platform designed to put AI influencer content production on autopilot. Agencies and creators build a character once, and the software manages subsequent content generation. The company claims its tool solves the problem of needing to constantly feed platforms with viral-ready ideas.

stories.title: Smartly named leader in creative tech report
stories.summary: Forrester Research named Smartly a leader in its Q4 2026 report on creative advertising technologies. The platform utilizes AI-orchestrated workflows and specialized agents to connect creative production with media activation. It currently operates across social, commerce, CTV, and LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Outreach adds ChatGPT skills to platform
stories.summary: Outreach has introduced new skills for ChatGPT, allowing revenue teams to access data and workflows directly within the AI assistant. The company also expanded its connector suite for the Model Context Protocol. These tools are designed to help teams act on revenue data across their existing application stack.

stories.title: Siteimprove launches accessibility agent on AWS
stories.summary: Siteimprove has released an accessibility agent on the AWS Marketplace. The tool allows AI agents to discover and pay for accessibility checks per request using Amazon Bedrock. This system turns each agent request into a monetization event while maintaining governance and cost visibility for the buyer.

stories.title: Messagepoint leads AI communications grid
stories.summary: Aspire Customer Communications Management named Messagepoint a leader in its new AI Intelligent Communications Platforms grid. The assessment evaluated how vendors apply AI across the communications value chain. Messagepoint was recognized for its strategy in advancing AI features beyond simple content generation or basic recommendations.

stories.title: Zocket uses AI to automate marketplace product pages
stories.summary: Zocket claims its AI Designer builds Amazon A+ content by applying visual rules to product facts. Co-founder Sundar says the product page is the new packaging, replacing the manual design queues that have failed to keep pace with modern catalogues. The packaging now arrives via software.

stories.title: OpenAI revises ChatGPT Business Hub terms following legal scrutiny
stories.summary: OpenAI updated its ChatGPT Business Hub terms days after launch. The revision followed reports that original language potentially restricted businesses from bringing legal claims against the company. The hub provides publishers with first-party data on how their websites appear in ChatGPT. The terms are now less restrictive.

research.title: Community-based fact-checking does not detectably reduce subsequent misleading posting by corrected users
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Community-based fact-checking can reduce the spread of annotated misleading posts, but whether it produces lasting behavioral change among corrected authors remains unclear. Here, we conduct a large-scale quasi-experimental study of the Community Notes system on X. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Control of Complex Social Systems via Committed Minorities and Opinion Broadcast
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Complex social systems are often characterized by a deep interconnection between individuals' opinion formation and their decision-making processes. In this chapter, we show how these two dynamics can be incorporated within a unifying game-theoretic coevolutionary model. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Do Network Mechanisms in Science Vary Across Research Topics? Contextual Relational Hyperevent Models for Large-Scale Bibliometric Data
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Collaboration and citation networks in science are shaped by well-documented mechanisms such as preferential attachment, gender homophily, and self-citation. Whether these mechanisms operate uniformly across research areas, however, is rarely tested, because statistical network models that. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: GEOHunter: Mapping a Generative Engine Optimization Network in the Wild
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Generative engines synthesize retrieved web pages into answers, recommendations, and rankings. Generative engine optimization (GEO) services sell visibility in these answers by publishing promotional articles on user-generated-content (UGC) platforms for paying clients. Such promotion raises concerns. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: How Network Topology and Data Heterogeneity Shape Decentralized Learning: A Spectral Analysis
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Network topology influences decentralized federated learning through information mixing and the relative contribution of individual nodes. While existing analyses primarily focus on spectral mixing properties, they often assume doubly stochastic aggregation, overlooking topology-dependent influence under irregular. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: UniCom: A Unified Framework for Community Search and Detection via Transfer Learning
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Searching and detecting communities in real-world graphs underpins a wide range of applications. Specifically, community search identifies a community for a given query, whereas community detection partitions the entire graph into multiple communities. Although they target. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: When Objectives and Evaluators Disagree: Evaluating Transfer for Post-hoc Demographic Framing Mitigation
research.summary: Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-hoc rewriting is used to reduce demographic disparities in LLM-generated text when the source model is inaccessible. A rewrite can look successful merely because it improved its own target or satisfied its selector. We study this. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
